statement: For a finite positive spectral measure nu with Fourier transform A, if int_R |A(t)|^2 dt<infinity then nu has an L2 Lebesgue density; for Poisson kernel P_eta, ||P_eta*nu||_2^2=(2pi)^-1 int_R exp(-2eta|t|)|A(t)|^2dt.
assumptions: nu finite; Fourier convention A(t)=int exp(-itE)nu(dE); eta>0.
source: w485 derivation in ATTEMPT.md, spectral theorem and Plancherel
proof_or_counterexample: Plancherel for finite measures; Fourier transform of P_eta is exp(-eta|t|).
independent_reviewer: w488 requested after review packet is frozen
remaining_gap: Criterion is not proved for C0056 at fixed lambda; referee check pending.

statement: For free adjacency on Z^3 and on a side-L discrete torus, origin return amplitudes differ by at most 2 sum_{k>=L}(6T)^k/k! uniformly for |t|<=T; nevertheless the infinite-volume local measure is a.c. and each finite torus is pure point.
assumptions: L>=3; H0 and HL nearest-neighbor adjacency; fixed finite T.
proof_or_counterexample: Closed-walk moments match for k<L because a walk cannot wrap; compare exponential Taylor tails using operator norm <=6. Fourier diagonalization gives the free-lattice a.c. density.
remaining_gap: No inference about fixed positive disorder; independent referee check pending.

statement: Pure a.c. spectrum by itself does not imply GOE finite-volume local statistics: free Z^3 adjacency has a.c. spectrum, while its periodic-box eigenvalue processes are deterministic and cannot converge in distribution to the nondegenerate GOE bulk process.
assumptions: Zero disorder; deterministic periodic boxes; fixed energy with positive density of states, e.g. E=0.
source: w485 proof in ATTEMPT.md; Bourgade 2018 separates the obligations
proof_or_counterexample: Free DOS is the convolution of three arcsine densities. Weak limits of Dirac probability laws on point-process space remain Dirac; GOE bulk law is nondegenerate.
remaining_gap: Does not address fixed positive disorder GOE; independent referee check pending.

statement: Combes-Germinet-Klein Eq. (1.4) plus the explicitly assumed conditional mark bound implies w483's 18 K R^2 W r off-diagonal pair bound; the conditional mark bound is unproved for the actual weak-disorder Z^3 model.
assumptions: Finite-volume independent bounded-density diagonal law R; cutoff support length W; E[a_j a_k|full ordered spectrum]<=K/N^2 and E sum a_j^2<=D/N.
proof_or_counterexample: At most 2W/r bins, Q length<=3r, so (K/N^2)(2W/r)(3RrN)^2=18KR^2Wr; diagonal <=D/N. No theorem supplies K.
remaining_gap: Uniform conditional eigenvector mark estimate at fixed positive disorder; GOE remains separate.
verdict: KEEP conditional implication; FIX if used as unconditional Anderson theorem

statement: w484's one-site cavity identity and conditional second-moment bounds are algebraically correct, but closing a fixed-disorder inverse-cavity-width bound remains open.
assumptions: H=A+lambda V on Z^3; iid bounded-density V0 independent of cavity; eta>0; lower bound specializes to V0 uniform[-1,1] and |a|+b<=lambda.
proof_or_counterexample: Condition on cavity and integrate b^2/((lambda v-a)^2+b^2)^2; full-line integral pi/(2b), resonant subinterval gives 1/(4lambda pi^2 b).
remaining_gap: Uniform control of E int_I b^{-1}dE on actual correlated cavity at fixed lambda; GOE separate.
verdict: KEEP exact conditional lemma; parent gap remains

statement: For the infinite-volume iid-uniform Z3 Anderson operator, a uniform logarithmic cavity-width expectation (LG) on a bounded interval J implies that every local spectral measure is absolutely continuous on J; it does not prove (LG).
assumptions: Fixed lambda>0; b_x(E,eta)=eta+Im cavity self-energy; sup_{0<eta<=1} E int_J log(1+1/b_x)dE<infinity; J bounded open.
proof_or_counterexample: Reproduced entropy integral, de la Vallee Poussin uniform integrability, Dunford-Pettis weak L1 limit, and identification via test functions h(omega)phi(E) plus Poisson weak convergence. Details REVIEW_W482.md.
remaining_gap: (LG) unproved for weak disorder at fixed positive lambda; GOE separate.
